Business uses forward PE, financials use forward ROE/PB, and cycle names use normalized earnings with explicit anti-double-haircut discipline. Financial PB fallback reads the target company own PB-MRQ row from Eastmoney peer-comparison data when bulk spot PB is unavailable; peer median is not substituted for target PB.
